Huawei Cloud SMS Host Migrator 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces automated, end-to-end host migration from on-premise or third-party clouds (Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, AWS) to Huawei Cloud ECS or Flexus X via Huawei Cloud Server Migration Service (SMS).
- Assists with agent deployment, pre-migration diagnostics, template provisioning, security group configuration, replication orchestration, incremental sync, and cutover validation.
- Supports discovery and migration of Linux and Windows source hosts, handling both file- and block-level replication.
- Provides detailed prerequisite checklists, network/security setup instructions, workflow guidance, and safe-guarding for mutating operations.
- Exposes core CLI commands for server discovery, pre-checks, status monitoring, and task management.
